card.title: Secrets Have Value
card.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

mechanism: A withholds the reason for taking a key until B offers a confession judged equally risky.
confusable: Unlike testing trust alone, A explicitly prices disclosure by a matched emotional or punitive cost.
comparison: Expected grounding duration prices family secrets, unlike the workplace scene's granular information and introductions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
